entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY, never combat. The Beings From Above (CONFIRMED) are jointed legs that descend silently while you are outside the car and capture you (death; their fate is unknown, the Level 0 wake-up is RUMORED and not built). Smilers/Wretches (CONFIRMED, extremely rare) appear only after parking for minutes: a grin in the fog, nails on the car, a fist on the window; no attack is rendered. The Whispers (REPORTED) are shared intrusive thoughts shown as subtitles.
content_note: The page describes people being speared or carried off by entities, crashes and starvation. Nothing graphic is shown.
notes: SOURCE: infinite highway, tall weathered concrete walls, no vehicles or civilisation apart from the highway, thick fog, pitch darkness, the only light is your own; you wake in the car at a random place (lane, heading and the tunnel's distance come from the seed); the car is the only safe place and fog/entities avoid it; Fragment Of Destivinatia in a hidden compartment at the bottom centre, removing it turns its effect off; parts may be broken (one headlight dead in ~30% of seeds); no fuel; crashing most likely kills; do not park too long; Beings From Above descend silently when you exit; stay near the car; the Whispers; the perpendicular one-lane tunnel, fog fading and roof lights turning on, ~17 h, the car breaks down and catches fire if driven too long after, walk the rest; no-clip through a side wall with the car to Level 22. ADAPTATION: cross-section (four lanes, 20 m between 9 m walls) and wall panelling are ours; the highway is a finite streaming window of 40 m chunks; the 17 hours are compressed to 150 s of driving inside the tunnel, which loops seamlessly (it is uniform) until the time is done, then a stair, landing and lit doorway appear ahead and the car dies; the tunnel walkway (+0.6 m) and end landing (+1.26 m) are ours; the no-clip spots (one about every 520 m, either side) are marked only by a slightly different panel and a crackle; the exposure clock (14 s, x0.35 near the car, x1.6 without the Fragment) and parked thresholds (150/240/320 s) are ours; the Whispers' phrases are written for the game. Not built: Level 4 (RUMORED on-foot no-clip) and Level 0 (RUMORED capture wake-up); flipped cars. QA fixture (QA mode only): start beside the dead car at the tunnel end so the walker bot walks out to Level 11.
